summary: Wire pr_watch_probe and pr_watch_summary into babysit --watch so quiet ticks use one conditional REST GET instead of full GraphQL reload (#1077).
migration_impact: No downstream repo migration. Watch mode behavior changes: unchanged PRs no longer wake the full babysit path every poll.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate-core when the release containing #1077 ships.
2. Rely on wake summaries on changed ticks; use --full-every N as an optional safety net for periodic full babysit.
3. Read docs/wiki/PR-Babysit-Wake-Summary.md for watcher loop semantics.
agent_notes: gh plate pr babysit --watch probes with If-None-Match each tick, runs full babysit only on first tick, actionable wake summaries, or --full-every N. Quiet ticks print 'No change; sleeping Ns' and exponential backoff without record_wake.
